elements.element: New York law governs the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 22.1 expressly provides that the Agreement and the parties’ rights and duties are governed by New York internal law.

elements.element: State and federal courts in New York County have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits, subject only to temporary injunctive relief elsewhere.
elements.evidence: Section 22.2 grants exclusive merits jurisdiction to state and federal courts in New York County, expressly subject only to temporary injunctive relief elsewhere. The separate post-judgment enforcement provision does not create an alternative merits forum.

elements.element: The governing law is Delaware, California, or England and Wales.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause selects New York law, not Delaware, California, or England and Wales law.

elements.element: The dispute forum is the corresponding Delaware or California courts, or the courts of London for England and Wales law.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause selects state and federal courts in New York County rather than any listed fallback forum.
